caption: The drawing depicts two identical spoons rendered in shades of gray, positioned vertically and side by side within a lightly outlined rectangular border on an off-white background. Each spoon has a pointed oval bowl and a handle with a decorative floral or leaf-like motif near both the bowl and the end of the handle. The spoons are evenly spaced, and both are oriented with their bowls facing up. The overall style of the drawing appears realistic, with careful attention to the shading and contours to create the metallic appearance of the objects. The rectangular border containing the spoons is centered on the page.
title: Pewter Spoon
